class.name: NetwSyncSetRow
class.brief_description: One declared property set, addressed by the wire ordinal a sync frame carries.
class.description: A row crosses out of [NetwSyncModel] as its own object rather than as a dictionary, because a caller reads four of its eight fields and a fixed-key dictionary across this seam is the shape that drifts. [member ordinal] is the row's whole wire address and is assigned by [NetwSyncModel], never by the declaring caller. Every other member is what the declaration said. [member policy] and [member audience] are the declaration's own gate columns, resolved once at registration rather than read from the set on every pass, so a sender that is native can decide who authors a row and who receives it without reaching a GDScript object.

members.member: Who the row's frames are for: [code]0[/code] every admitted peer, [code]1[/code] the server alone. Matches [code]NetwPropertySet.Audience[/code].
The component address the declaring node resolved to inside its entity.
The structural registration key, the declaring node's path relative to its entity owner. One half of what makes a declaration distinct inside a route.
[constant NetwSyncModel.KIND_CONSUMED] or [constant NetwSyncModel.KIND_DERIVED]. Every consumed row holds a lower [member ordinal] than every derived one.
The row's address on the wire, assigned by sorting the route's declarations rather than by the order they arrived.
Who may author the row's stream: [code]0[/code] the node's multiplayer authority, [code]1[/code] the entity's controller, [code]2[/code] any peer. Matches [code]NetwScriptModel.Policy[/code].
The set's record kind. Matches [code]NetwPropertySet.Record[/code], and a state row is server-authored whatever [member policy] says.
The entity route the declaration belongs to.
The declared set itself, as the session knows it.
The wire hash of the set's column shape, which is what a receiver checks a frame against before decoding it.
